notes.title: Bundle Release: Get All Our Studio's Roguelikes at Once!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that you can now purchase (or complete your collection of) all three of our roguelikes at a significant discount. This bundle might interest those who want to track the progress of our tiny studio over the years. If you particularly enjoy any of the games, please don't hesitate to leave a review on its page. This helps us tremendously and shows us that people want more games like it.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43539/Think_and_Watch/

Meanwhile, we are working on something very secret, so shhh... Stay tuned!

notes.title: From Predictors to AutoHeroes: Experience our New Game in Early Access Today!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! If you’re a fan of Predictors and are looking for something similar, you might be interested in revisiting old heroes in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2403940/AutoHeroes/]our new game - AutoHeroes[/url]. If you’re unsure, there’s a free demo version that you can play with friends.

What sets AutoHeroes apart from Predictors? 

Firstly, AutoHeroes is not a turn-based tactic, but an autobattler. This means you make strategic decisions about your characters’ development and priorities, but you don’t plan every step. You don’t even see the map during the planning stage! The gameplay is quite different, even though you’ll see familiar characters.

Secondly, the overall style is different. We’ve moved away from the dark roguelike to a cheerful hack and slash that you can enjoy without too much strain. We’ve also tried to eliminate some of the aspects that frustrated people in Predictors - primarily those related to the game’s difficulty.

In short, we look forward to seeing you and your friends, especially now that there’s a significant discount on the new game. Still unsure? Try the demo. Enjoyed the game? We’d appreciate a review. Happy gaming!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2403940/AutoHeroes/

notes.title: Try the "Predictors" Demo (Solo or With Friends!)
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce that you now have the opportunity to play the game for free via our demo version. 

[b]Here's what's available in it:[/b]

[list]
[*] Tutorial and full completion of the game at the first difficulty level as a knight.
[*] The ability to play with friends who are also playing the demo version.
[*] The option to use low-level artifacts as a reward from previous runs.
[/list]

[b]However, please be aware of the following limitations:[/b]

[list]
[*] Completion at other difficulty levels up to 10 is not available.
[*] Earning and using high-level artifacts in new runs is not supported.
[*] Playing as an archer or a wizard is not possible.
[*] Playing with friends who are using the full version is not permitted.
[/list]

We hope you'll enjoy your time in the Dark Forest! :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2149330/Predictors/

notes.title: Full Release is here!
notes.notes:
Greetings Predictors!

Today with a big balance patch that polishes different numbers in the game for more interesting choices, "Predictors" is out of Early Access. Thank you all who help to make it better during these months!

Saying that doesn't mean that the game's development is stopped. While serious updates depend heavily on demand, we are determined to watch game balance and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2149330/view/5254045511855102700]still want to improve additional languages to support them[/url] - don't hesitate to get in touch with us if you want that too and can help with your language :)

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: The new translations (Update)
notes.notes:
Hi Predictors! 

Now the game officially supports three languages.

You can also switch the game to one of the other languages whose translations still need improvement:

[list]
[*] Spanish
[*] German
[*] Polish
[*] Portuguese
[*] Turkish
[/list]

Please let us know if you can help fix additional languages.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Big Multiplayer Update: invite up to 3 friends, share loot, and more.
notes.notes:
Hi predictors!

- The last update allows you to play together with up to 3 steam friends (so four players max);
- Important UI improvement for multiplayer: now every player sees the first step from every ally;
- Enemies are scaling now: they have more health for every player.
- Now you have common loot - it means every player gets the same artifacts and resources (except health and mana potions).

We are watching closely and going to improve balance or fix bugs if we find something new.

[previewyoutube=vcHipNOhzog;full][/previewyoutube]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Complete game rework: let's go tight!
notes.notes:
Hi Predictors,

If you'd like to see what the gameplay looks like after the update, we've updated the single-player and co-op gameplay videos [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2149330/Predictors]on the game page[/url].

The game and the tutorial were reworked - no more wandering around the big map. Now you fight in small areas. Then grab your loot and choose the next area you want to go to - maybe, you want more powerful potions or to improve your artifacts.

Every step is important now, and now you even see the counter about leveling of enemies.

Health and mana-restoring skills are also reworked - now you regenerate them during going through portals.

You can still play alone or with a friend, but now you have to fight together.

We also have cleared the leaderboards.

Enjoy! 

And Merry Christmas ;)

notes.title: More everything: meta-progression, customization, enemies, quality of life
notes.notes:
Hi Predictors! 

We worked so hard last weeks, and now we can't wait while you try the last updates.

[b]Meta-progression and customization[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42956433/cfab4ab46ae1f6bb51191f302005c8efeb2e0615.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Now, you get a reward after every game - it could be a helm, armor, or weapon. All those items could be different rarities. 
[*] Each gives you different bonuses: helms improve your potions, weapons - attacks, armor - your empowering skills. [i]If you like hunting for better loot - higher difficulties have higher chances for greater rewards.[/i]
[/list]
[b]New enemies[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42956433/3cb9d5260ce710cad60ac14316774c99312bc1b4.png[/img]

[list]
[*] As we promised, now there are two new types of enemies (and six in total). Vampires and Ghosts are pretty strong opponents (and, one can say, very funny minions if you have necromancy ;) ). Vampires steal your health, Ghosts can clone themselves, and their attacks are improved when they have allies around. 
[*] [i]Yes, we know what you can think about them - as almost every enemy except Lich Lord, they can become your faithful minions. We love necromancy too! But we are watching closely - it should be fun and useful, but not just one useful skill. In fact, necromancy shouldn't be stronger than other skills.[/i]
[/list]
[b]Balance, DIfficulty, and enemy spawning reworked.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42956433/505c947e02e237dd8e024f0aed20eacdd7724e4d.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Now,[i] enemies on higher difficulties started with levels higher than 1[/i]. They still are getting stronger faster the higher the difficulty is.
[*] Now stronger enemies appear a bit later than common ones. You won't see vampires and ghosts for a while, but they will finally come - even in the tutorial.
[*] Different enemies and skills tweaks.
[/list]
[b]New UI improvements[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42956433/7780c1b7c3625330f2e7198537d60ab5b93bab48.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Hotkeys for active skills to more dynamic play - [i]as we play this game A LOT, we love it![/i]
[*] Visual quality options - some people play on laptops and sometimes even report problems with the game launch. Now there are options to change the resolution and visual quality overall - we hope it helps many to enjoy the game.
[/list]
P.S. We changed gameplay videos on the store page to reflex new mechanics - there are a few minutes of single and coop games.

Have a good game!

notes.title: Witch is here - 6 new ways to improve your heroes (necromancy included ;) )
notes.notes:
Play by yourself and grab a friend to play coop - check out the most significant game's Early Access update for now.

In a few words:

There are four witch huts on the map. Find magic flowers and go to the witch - there are six passive skills she can improve through the potions. Need necromancy or ancestral spirit to help? Here you are. Ever wonder about frozen or fire magic? Or maybe, a unique class ability or the possibility to use some skills without cooldowns? Look no further!

We will focus on special effects, animations, and UI improvements in the next updates.

Have a nice game!

notes.title: Greetings and upcoming plans
notes.notes:
Right now, we're busy working on the special effects. While it's not as important as the core game mechanics, adding special effects can significantly increase the game's immersion. Along the way, we are tracking bugs and game balance.

We have created a topic where you can chat with the developers: ask questions, share suggestions for consideration, etc.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2149330/discussions/0/3385042609876938140/

If you have already managed to play the current version and wish the game to be developed as much as possible, we will be grateful for the review on the game page.

Have a good day!
